data.name: Shiva
data.gender_notes: Shiva is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śiva, 'auspicious, benevolent, kind'. Its root is Sanskrit śiva (शिव). Shiva, one of the principal deities of Hinduism. Shiva is a Sanskrit name meaning “Auspicious; benevolent”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shiva expresses “Auspicious; benevolent”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śiva, 'auspicious, benevolent, kind'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shiva total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
